records.subject: You're in -- let's get Summit Collective set up
records.body:
Hi Aisha,

Welcome! A lot of new teams ask us the same thing in the first few days: how do I get my team in here. Short answer -- a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Reply any time.

Cheers,
Priya Chen

decisions.rationale: 6 days in with zero engagement: no reply to either outreach [email:c48eb423], [email:85530995], no tickets, no project, no invite. Silent self-serve Starter accounts that haven't created a project by day 6 rarely activate unaided in the remaining 8 days.

draft.subject: A hand getting your first Summit Collective project up
draft.body:
Hi Aisha,

Following up on my welcome note — I know launch weeks get busy. In Wrenfield, projects are the main organizing unit, and tasks live inside them, so setting up one real project is usually the quickest way to see whether this fits how your team works. The in-app onboarding flow walks through creating a first project, and when you're ready, a teammate can be invited from Account Settings -> Members at any time.

Would a 15-minute call this week help? I'm happy to walk through your first project with you and answer anything as it comes up.

Best,
Priya
